title: Savage Labyrinth
items: 50 floors of combat under Outset Island — requires the Power Bracelets

Floors are grouped in 5 ten-floor blocks, each pulling enemies from a different dungeon: 1-10 Dragon Roost Cavern, 11-20 Forbidden Woods, 21-30 Tower of the Gods, 31-40 Earth Temple, 41-50 Wind Temple (with a wider mix of enemy types than the other blocks) — full per-floor breakdown below
Every 10th floor is a rest floor with an exit plus pots of hearts and rupees; the entrance room before floor 1 also hides a pot with 3 Fairies
Floor 30 hides a Triforce Chart/Shard — play Wind's Requiem on the Wind Crest to reveal the chest
Floor 50 (HD version) rewards the Hero's Charm, which highlights hidden items on the map
Dying resets you to floor 1 — go in with full hearts and a full bomb bag

title: Nintendo Gallery
items: Carlov, on Windfall Island, carves figurines from your pictographs
134 possible figurines in total, organized by category
The Deluxe Picto Box holds up to 12 photos at once (HD)
Carlov can carve up to 12 figurines in parallel (HD) — bring him several photos at once

title: Zunari's trading sequence
items: Starts by buying the Town Flower from Zunari for 10 rupees
Trade it with the wandering merchants on Bomb Island, Greatfish Isle, and Mother and Child Isles
The chain has about 12 items, each unlocking the next trade
Ends with a Piece of Heart and Magic Armor (halves damage taken in exchange for rupees)

title: Great Fairies
items: Each fountain grants a Quiver or Bomb Bag upgrade in exchange for rupees
Fountains are found on Southern Fairy Island, Cliff Plateau Isles, and other islands across the Great Sea
Upgrades raise capacity from 30 to 60, then 60 to 99

title: Windfall Island minigames
items: Salvatore's Sinking Ships — sink ships with the hand cannon
The cannon minigame against floating targets
Hide-and-seek with the Killer Bees, via Mrs. Marie
Night auctions — bid against other customers for items and Pieces of Heart

title: Tingle Statues (HD exclusive)
items: 5 Tingle Statues, new to the HD version, each hidden as a bombable chest inside a dungeon
Dragon Roost Cavern: grapple across the lava pit on the path to the boss key, then bomb the alcove
Forbidden Woods: the basement room where you found a Treasure Chart, on the way to the boss key
Tower of the Gods: ride the platforms up in the first tall round room, then look for one floating apart from the rest
Earth Temple: glide with the Deku Leaf from the bridge with two blue Bubbles to a hidden ledge
Wind Temple: in the room where Makar is first grabbed by Floormasters, bomb the pit in front of you
Not required to complete the main story
